{{Quote|You kids just can't seem to keep yourselves out of trouble, now can you?''"<br />"''Dunari!''"<br />"''Let me guess. You don't find trouble, trouble finds you?|Dunari and Aeron Azzameen|<ref name="xwa" />}}
The [[Azzameen family]] carried out a '''mission''' to [[Kessel Station]] just prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

Following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the Azzameen family business, [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]], gave aid to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the form of [[Bacta/Legends|Bacta]] shipments. During delivery of one shipment, family patriarch [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen]] and his eldest son [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin Azzameen]] were believed [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. Following reclamation of their previously [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets|Imperialized]] home base, Tomaas's brother [[Antan Azzameen]] claimed that his brother and nephew were actually [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]], not killed. He led his surviving niece and nephews to Kessel Station, allegedly to free their father and brother.

The raid was actually a ruse to deliver the surviving Azzameens into the hands of Imperial authorities. Antan Azzameen fled the [[Kessel system/Legends|system]], while the remaining Azzameens were left to fight their way out of the trap. Due to the [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] influence of the nearby [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw]] cluster, the Azzameen siblings had difficulty plotting a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] course, and seemed likely to be captured until family friend [[Dunari]] appeared and provided an escape course. The group then made its way out of Imperial territory and back to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] with a minimum of fuss.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Family means more to me than the Empire or the Rebellion.|Antan Azzameen|<ref name="xwa" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in the period between the pivotal battles of [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]], the [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]] company owned by the [[Azzameen family]] covertly lent its aid to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. While delivering a shipment of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] to the Rebel [[XQ2 Platform]] [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|Hospital]], family patriarch [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen]] and his eldest son [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin]] were believed [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a [[Battle of Hospital|raid]] by forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="xwab0m6">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 0, Mission 6: "Rebel Rendezvous: Aid to the Alliance"</ref> In response to their [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Empire, all Azzameen family assets [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets|were seized]] and warrants were issued against all members of the family.<ref name="xwab0m7">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 0, Mission 7: "Nowhere To Go?: Escape Imperial Attack"</ref>

The family's youngest child, [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]], joined the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] following this tragedy,<ref name="xwab0m8">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 0, Mission 8: "Deep Space Strike Evaluation"</ref> while his remaining family&mdash;older sister [[Aeron Azzameen]], older brother [[Emon Azzameen]], and uncle [[Antan Azzameen]]&mdash;continued to operate in a freelance capacity against both the Empire and their rival family, the [[Viraxo]].<ref name="xwab1m2">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 1, Mission 2: "Rescue Uncle Antan"</ref> In his capacity as a Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Ace Azzameen was tasked with [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] the base of operations for a [[Falcon's Nest mercenaries|group]] of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who were attempting to sour relations between the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]]. Assisted by his sister Aeron, Ace Azzameen discovered that his family's primary place of business and residence, [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Station]], had fallen into the hands of these mercenaries.<ref name="xwab6m2">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 6, Mission 2: "Locate Mercenary Base"</ref> As a reprisal against the inhabitants of the newly renamed "Falcon's Nest," the Alliance waged a successful [[Battle of Azzameen Station|battle]] to retake the station.<ref name="xwab6m3">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 6, Mission 3: "Raid Mercenary Base"</ref>

Following this battle, Antan Azzameen called a meeting of the Azzameen family at their reclaimed home. He admitted that he had been [[Privateer/Legends|contracted]] by the Empire to use the mercenaries that formerly occupied the station to damage the Rebellion. The elder Azzameen claimed to his niece and nephews that he only did so in order to secure the safety of his brother Tomaas and eldest nephew Emon, and that the Rebels had jeopardized his plan by successfully thwarting the mercenaries. He told the assembled Azzameen family members that their father and brother were being held at the [[Golan III Space Defense NovaGun|heavily armed platform]] of [[Kessel Station]], [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. According to Antan, the only remaining way for the Azzameen family to free their imprisoned relatives was to [[Hyperspace/Legends|travel]] to the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]] and take them by force.<ref name="xwab6m7" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|If we make it out of this one, it will be a miracle.''"<br />"''If we make out of this one, our ''uncle'' will need the miracle.|Aeron and Emon Azzameen|<ref name="xwa" />}}
The Azzameen family departed from Azzameen Station in their usual starships: Emon in his [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray''-class attack craft]], ''[[Andrasta]]'', Antan commanding the [[Action IV transport]] ''[[Big Score]]'', and Ace and the family's trusted [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]] piloting the [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'' with Aeron as their passenger. Antan Azzameen claimed that he had connections that would allow the family to safely enter the Kessel system and dock with Kessel Station. After entering the system without interference from any authorities, the Azzameens would first have to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into the records of the control station to learn which of the [[Kessel Station Holding Cell]]s held their imprisoned family members. The ''Otana'' flew to Kessel Station and docked, then Aeron commenced slicing the records. She was concerned when she was unable to find any Azzameens listed among the prison records, but Antan implored her to keep looking.<ref name="xwab6m7" />

[[File:DumDumDumDumDaDumDumDaDum-XWA.png|thumb|left|''Devastator'' attempts to apprehend the Azzameen family.]]
As Aeron continued her search,<ref name="xwab6m7" /> the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial-I'' class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="V:TUG" /> [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] entered the Kessel system. The ''Devastator'' signaled a demand for the Azzameen [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to surrender to the Empire. Antan signaled a response to the ''Devastator'' indicating that he had fulfilled the terms of his bargain with the Empire by delivering his other family members into their hands. The Azzameen siblings were incensed to learn that their uncle had betrayed them to save himself, and their father and brother had indeed died at the Rebel platform.<ref name="xwab6m7" />

As the ''Devastator'' launched dozens of [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] starfighters, a mix of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|basic models]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|interceptors]], Antan Azzameen fled the scene. The Azzameen siblings scrambled to escape the Imperials, but MK-09's hyperspace calculations were complicated by the [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] anomalies of [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] cluster adjacent to the Kessel system.<ref name="xwab6m7" /> The siblings held off the Imperial starfighters for a while, but it appeared to be a hopeless situation.<ref name="xwasg" /> Then, to the great surprise of the Azzameen siblings, family friend [[Dunari]] appeared to assist in his [[Muurian transport]], ''[[Deadman's Hand]]''. As a former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who made the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]] with their father Tomaas, Dunari knew how to lead the Azzameen siblings out of the system and away from the Empire's wrath.<ref name="xwab6m7" />

Although Emon was willing to continue the engagement, Ace was eager to escape. Deferring to his younger brother's better judgment, Emon followed the ''Otana'' and ''Deadman's Hand'' away from Kessel Station.<ref name="xwasg" /> Their hyperspace course first took them to a point near [[Asteroid Mining Unit]] [[XP-MU 3376]] and [[Processing Plant]] [[AL-82673]] in the Kessel system's [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]], which were guarded by [[Outpost AS-27]], a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] [[Asteroid Hangar|concealed in an asteroid]]. As they flew past the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] to the next [[Hyperspace jump point/Legends|jump point]], the Azzameens and Dunari dodged [[Asteroid Laser Battery|laser batteries]] and even a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE advanced]] starfighters. The fleeing transports were able to evade the ''Devastator''{{'s}} attempted pursuit, and returned to the relative safety of the Rebel fleet and the [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']].<ref name="xwab6m7" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|But what about Antan?''"<br />"''We'll have to deal with him later. Don't worry, he'll get his.|MK-09 and Dunari|<ref name="xwa" />}}
Following their escape, Dunari swore to the Azzameens that the treacherous Antan would receive his comeuppance.<ref name="xwab6m7" /> However, Ace Azzameen and MK-09 had little time for vengeance in the days immediately following their mission to Kessel. The Rebel Alliance mounted an attack against the second [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]],<ref name="xwab7" /> and both Ace Azzameen and MK-09 joined the assault as part of the crew of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. The pair survived the battle, and MK-09 eventually made a record of their exploits, which made no mention of further actions against Antan Azzameen.<ref name="xwasg" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Kessel Station appears only in the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|personal computer]] game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', which was developed for [[LucasArts]] by [[Totally Games]] and released on [[February 28]], 1999.<ref name="xwa" /><ref name="This Week! Ep5">{{ThisWeek|aXaqpI-IARE|Star Wars: The High Republic Debuts, The Magic Behind The Mandalorian, and More!|sw_url=video/star-wars-the-high-republic-debuts-the-magic-behind-the-mandalorian-and-more}}</ref> There are no bonus objectives or other gameplay-based alternatives in this mission, the only objectives are to dock with Kessel Station, then to flee the situation intact.<ref name="xwab6m7" /> The [[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|official strategy guide]] calls it a "walk in the park."<ref name="xwasg" /> The Kessel mission itself was not given a proper name by the source in which it appears, though the game level which includes both the mission and some of its preceding events is called "Family Reunion" by the game and its corresponding official strategy guide.<ref name="xwab6m7" /><ref name="xwasg" />

This mission, as with most missions in ''X-Wing Alliance'', is not specifically dated by the game or secondary sources. Its timing can only be estimated by preceding and succeeding events that have been given specific dates, but it can be pinpointed to the second half of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The series of missions preceding the Azzameen mission to Kessel Station, "Battle 4: 'The Bothan Connection,'" depicts the events leading to the [[Raid on the Suprosa|raid on the ''Suprosa'']] to acquire the [[Death Star II plans]]. This is a tie-in to the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|''Shadows of the Empire'']] meta-series, which is dated to "3.5 ABY" by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The missions immediately following the mission to Kessel, "Battle 7: 'The Battle of Endor,'" are specifically dated to the beginning of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" /> Therefore, this mission can be dated to "c. 3.5&ndash;4 ABY"

Although sources such as ''[[Vader: The Ultimate Guide]]'' identify the ''Devastator'' as an ''Imperial-I'' class Star Destroyer,<ref name="V:TUG" /> ''X-wing Alliance'' and the [[Prima Games]] strategy guide depict it as an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial-II'' class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="xwab6m7" /><ref name="xwasg" /> This article assumes the preponderance of other sources are correct and the game is in error.

''X-Wing Alliance'' was included in the continuity now known as "[[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]" along with most other ''Star Wars'' materials produced before [[April 25]], [[2014]].<ref name="FUDisney">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> As it was the final game in the [[X-Wing (game series)|''X-Wing'' series]] and as LucasArts is now closed,<ref name="seriouslyFUDisney">{{WebCite|url=http://www.joystiq.com/2013/04/03/disney-closes-lucasarts|text=Disney closes LucasArts|author=Sliwinski, Alexander|date=2013-04-03|language=English|quote=Disney, which acquired Lucasfilm and LucasArts last year in a $4.05 billion deal, has shut down the legendary LucasArts division.|archivedate=20130403205142}}</ref> the fates of Antan Azzameen and his family will likely remain unknown.
